ma.getImageInfo(Object object)

Obtain image information. Network images take effect only after the download domain name is configured.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
src String Yes Image path, which can be a network path, local path, or code package path. (The simulator does not support a local path.The code package path is case sensitive.)
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
width Number Original image width, in pixels. Rotation is not considered.
height Number Original image height, in pixels. Rotation is not considered.
path String Local path of an image.
orientation String Device direction during photographing (not supported by the simulator)
type String Image format.

Valid Values of res.orientation

Value Description
up Default direction (the phone takes photos horizontally) corresponding to 1 in Exif or no orientation information.
up-mirrored Mirror flipping. Similar to up. Corresponding to 2 in Exif.
down Rotation by 180 degrees, corresponding to 3 in Exif.
down-mirrored Mirror flipping. Similar to down. Corresponding to 4 in getImageInfo.
left-mirrored Mirror flipping. Similar to left. Corresponding to 5 in Exif.
right Clockwise rotation by 90 degrees, corresponding to 6 in Exif.
right-mirrored Mirror flipping. Similar to right. Corresponding to 7 in Exif.
left Counterclockwise rotation by 90 degrees, corresponding to 8 in Exif.

Sample Code

ma.getImageInfo({
  src: 'images/a.jpg',
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.width);
    console.log(res.height);
  }
});

ma.chooseImage({
  success(res) {
    ma.getImageInfo({
      src: res.tempFilePaths[0],
      success(res) {
        console.log(res.width);
        console.log(res.height);
      }
    });
  }
});
